create_LogicalExpr: create a LogicalExpr with AND/OR/NAND/NOR type combining PDDL predicates or subexpressions
evaluate_is_true: evaluate whether a LogicalExpr is true given a PddlSimInfo simulation state
check_is_true_from_predicates: check if a LogicalExpr is true by comparing against a list of Predicate objects
clone_LogicalExpr: clone a LogicalExpr to create a deep copy with all subexpressions duplicated
substitute_entities_sub_in_clone: substitute PDDL entities in a LogicalExpr and return a new cloned expression
